leakage_controls.target: prcp_mm shifted forward by one calendar observation (next day)
leakage_controls.rolling_features: Historical precipitation shifted by one row before 3/7/14-day rolling means
leakage_controls.current_prcp_mm: Observed on the prediction day; not the next-day target

training_configuration.threshold_selection: Validation-only randomized search over class probability thresholds; objective is priority recall mean plus 10% weighted F1

improvement_decision: Retained baseline: no model met validation requirement of meaningful HIGH and CRITICAL recall without unacceptable class tradeoffs
